summary: Sponsor-reported combined-dose benefit and replacement-site progress support the application. The prior manufacturing setback is mitigated, not demonstrably closed: FDA acceptance of the apitegromab-specific replacement pathway remains unresolved. Safety results are not supplied.
pivotalQuestion: Has FDA accepted the replacement facility’s apitegromab-specific manufacturing package and completed any required facility assessments?

factors.rationale: Sponsor reported a 1.8-point week-52 HFMSE advantage for prespecified combined doses versus placebo on background therapy (p=0.0192); 20 mg/kg alone was not significant (p=0.1149).
The supplied packet contains no interpretable adverse-event results. Safety-related study titles and routine regulatory update requests do not establish tolerability or a safety signal.

Sponsor reports Catalent removal following the CRL/OAI setback, alternative-site package submission, and available vials. These mitigate the setback, but product-specific FDA acceptance remains unestablished; no replacement-site defect is documented.
Sponsor reports FDA-guided Catalent removal and continued review with the September 30 target retained. These process developments do not establish approval or closure of all application issues.
